title: CAT 2024 Question Paper (Slot 1, PYQ) - Quant - Algebra
subject: Quant

questions.q: If the equations $x^2 + mx + 9 = 0$, $x^2 + nx + 17 = 0$ and $x^2 + (m+n)x + 35 = 0$ have a common negative root, then the value of $(2m+3n)$ is
questions.explain: Let the common negative root be $a$. So $a^2 + ma + 9 = 0$, $a^2 + na + 17 = 0$, and $a^2 + (m+n)a + 35 = 0$. Adding the first two equations gives $2a^2 + (m+n)a + 26 = 0$. Subtracting the third equation from this: $(2a^2 + (m+n)a + 26) - (a^2 + (m+n)a + 35) = 0 \implies a^2 - 9 = 0$. So $a = -3$ (since it is negative). Substituting $a = -3$ in $x^2 + mx + 9 = 0 \implies 9 - 3m + 9 = 0 \implies 3m = 18 \implies m = 6$. Substitute in $x^2 + nx + 17 = 0 \implies 9 - 3n + 17 = 0 \implies 3n = 26 \implies n = 26/3$. We need $2m + 3n = 2(6) + 3(26/3) = 12 + 26 = 38$.
